intent.dramatic_purpose: Maximized emotional resonance of resignation as the vast, dark world under the shattered moon slowly dissolves into total blackness.
intent.duration_justification: Allows the lingering quiet weight of the ruined world to settle before full darkness.
intent.audience_focus: The dimming landscape of the hilltop and the vast pitch-black Earth fading out completely.

layers.foreground: Silhouetted cracked hilltop ridge with the tiny forms of Journey and his telescope tripod.
layers.midground: Vast expanse of pitch-black Earth shrouded in cold shadow.
layers.background: Deep night sky filled with glowing lunar fragment rings and distorted moonlight.

framing.focal_point: The tiny silhouetted hilltop disappearing into total darkness.

character_blocking.pose: Standing tiny and motionless beside his telescope tripod on the ridge

prop_placement.significance: A small, helpless monument of observation facing the dark world.

static_spec.texture_notes: Deep void textures, subtle moonlight sheen on dark landscape, fading shadow.
static_spec.color_grading_intent: Extreme low-key cold blue-black monochrome dissolving into total black.
static_spec.first_frame_prompt: An extreme wide shot of the dark Earth under a ruined night sky. At the bottom center, a tiny silhouette of Journey and his telescope tripod rests on the cracked hilltop ridge, framed next to a dead angular tree silhouette. Distorted orange lunar glow dims across the cold navy landscape.

dynamic_spec.motion_prompt: The image slowly dims and fades into complete darkness over the silent landscape.
